_meta.indication: Treatment of adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, whose disease has progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy.

pivotal_trials.design: International, open-label, multicohort, single-arm, 3-part dose-escalation and dose-expansion trial (efficacy from Pooled Prior Platinum Analysis Set).
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations whose disease had progressed on or after platinum-based chemotherapy.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Overall response rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent central review (BICR); duration of response (DOR) as additional measure.
pivotal_trials.result: ORR 28% (95% CI 20, 37) by BICR; median DOR 17.5 months (95% CI 7.4, 20.3); 59% of responders had DOR ≥6 months.

key_safety: Most common (>20%) adverse reactions: diarrhea, rash, nausea, stomatitis, vomiting, decreased appetite, paronychia, fatigue, dry skin, and musculoskeletal pain. In the N=114 population, diarrhea occurred in 92% (22% Grade 3/4) and rash in 78%. Most serious risks: QTc prolongation/Torsades de Pointes, ILD/pneumonitis, cardiac toxicity, and diarrhea.
target_moa: Mobocertinib is an oral, irreversible kinase (EGFR TKI) inhibitor designed to selectively inhibit EGFR with exon 20 insertion mutations over wild-type EGFR; it inhibited all 14 mutant EGFR variants in cellular assays (IC50 2.4–22 nM) at lower concentrations than WT EGFR (IC50 35 nM).

boxed_warning.content: QTc prolongation and Torsades de Pointes: EXKIVITY can cause life-threatening heart rate-corrected QT (QTc) prolongation, including Torsades de Pointes, which can be fatal, requiring monitoring of QTc and electrolytes at baseline and periodically.

rems.type: FDA did not consider a REMS necessary to ensure the safe and effective use of mobocertinib.

companion_dx_detail: EGFR exon 20 insertion mutation detected by an FDA-approved test; 70% of tissue samples were tested retrospectively using the Life Technologies Corporation Oncomine Dx Target Test.

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during the review.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Overall response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR).

confirmatory_requirement.text: Conduct a multicenter, randomized clinical trial and submit final PFS results verifying and describing the clinical benefit of mobocertinib in NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations (PMR 4148-1).
